dedupe_keys.name: регистър на заявленията за достъп до информация и движението им през 2021 г

description: Регистър на заявленията за достъп до информация и движението им през 2021 г is a dataset listed in Open Data Bulgaria, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Милка Асенова. The register contains information for 2021, order number and date of application, type of information requested, applicant, decision on access to information, decision to refuse, reply to the applicant if the application has been forwarded for a decision on competence to another institution or in cases where the authority does not have the requested ... Coverage: Милка Асенова. The portal shows the English title as "Register of applications for access to information and their movement in 2021" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Милка Асенова. Its keywords include заявления, околна среда, РМС 436/2017, информация, регистър, достъп. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-bulgaria.
